twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Protect password sign-in with a temporary code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator…). Passkeys are not affected.
twoFactor.setupPasswordStep: Confirm your password to get started.
twoFactor.setupScanStep: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.setupCodesStep: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Keep these backup codes somewhere safe.
twoFactor.invalidCode: Invalid code. Check your device clock and try again.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Sign-in will only ask for your password. Your backup codes will be deleted.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your previous backup codes will stop working immediately.
twoFactor.backupCodesHelp: Each code allows a single sign-in if you lose access to your app. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.backupCodesFileHeader: Vectorix backup codes — each code can be used only once.
